mapper.select: SELECT SUM(re.score) FROM sys_result re JOIN sys_task ta ON re.task_id = ta.id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = re.u_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE re.is_finish = 1 AND re.p_id = #{pId} AND u.user_id = #{teacher} GROUP BY ta.category
select task_id from sys_result where p_id=#{pId} and u_id=#{teacherId}
